summary: Replaced the global settings with an immutable Settings, make(), and an explicit conf parameter through all pricing, packing, geo, output, service and command code. Import-time and stale values (units factors, holidays, fuel factor, freight minimum, zone table, fx factors, dim divisor, tax default) now depend on conf, and the cache is keyed by settings value. CLI output matched the original across about 1,000 runs, and the tests are moved to the new API.
